svg.text: Every patient, one by one: seizures caught by Model A (EEG) and Model C (all signals)
96 development patients sorted by number of seizures (bar width proportional to seizures). Blue dot = A, teal dot = C; a line between them is the gain from fusion. Seed-mean, xgb, tuned threshold.
Model C · EEG + ECG + EMG + ACC
← patients with many seizures (number shown) … patients with few seizures (unlabelled) →
Red columns: sub-039, sub-047, sub-035 — 28 % of all seizures, median length 10–13 s, 2–37 % caught.

Without them, the "right-montage problem" (0.17) becomes 0.45. These short seizures, not the invisible ones, are the main loss — and they are a post-processing problem (window and k-of-n), not a feature problem.
Source: results/dev/v01_baseline/scores_by_patient.csv (xgb, mean over 3 seeds). No patient is hidden in an average.
